categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Real-Design Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent controllers, lithium battery PACKs, and some terminal products. The company focuses on smart controllers for home appliances, motor electric controls, automotive electronics, and digital intelligent power sources, while also exploring emerging sectors such as medical health, pet technology, low-altitude flight, and smart home industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes microcontroller chips and digital signal processors integrated with embedded systems, sensors, algorithms, and communication technologies to develop intelligent controllers. Production employs a digitalized manufacturing system with advanced automation equipment and information management systems including ERP, APS, MES, QMS, SCM, and WMS. The manufacturing process supports customized, small-batch production with flexible assembly lines and DIP technology for circuit board assembly.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading enterprises in home appliances, automotive electronics, and smart home sectors such as Midea, Supor, Ninebot, and others. The company serves domestic and international markets, providing intelligent control solutions primarily for home appliance manufacturers, electric motor producers, automotive electronics firms, and emerging digital power source industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production bases in Foshan, Guangdong Province. It has expanded internationally with a manufacturing base in Dong Nai, Vietnam, supporting global market penetration, especially in Southeast Asia. Domestic sales account for over 97% of revenue, with a small portion from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Real-Design operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of intelligent controllers and related electronic components. It maintains independent and complete R&D, procurement, production, and sales systems, positioning itself as a key solution provider within the intelligent control industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with significant R&D investment focused on AIoT integration, multi-modal sensing, IoT protocol adaptation, and advanced control algorithms. Strategic priorities include upgrading traditional home appliance control products, expanding new business tracks like automotive electronics and digital power sources, and exploring emerging fields such as medical health and smart homes. It also pursues digital transformation and global capacity expansion, notably through its Vietnam base.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized intelligent controllers and related products to domestic and international customers. The company follows an order-driven production model, aligning manufacturing with confirmed customer orders. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income, but product sales constitute the core revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As a pioneer and leading enterprise in the intelligent controller industry with over 20 years of experience, Guangdong Real-Design holds a strong market position supported by advanced R&D capabilities, a comprehensive quality management system, and stable partnerships with major industry players. It is recognized as a high-tech and intellectual property demonstration enterprise in China, competing with other domestic and international intelligent controller manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.26 billion, representing an 18.06% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 38.2 million, a slight decline of 6.49%. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 1.85 billion and net assets of RMB 1.26 billion. It has demonstrated steady revenue growth driven by traditional and new business segments, with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangdong Real-Design emphasizes high-quality, customized intelligent control solutions with strong technological innovation as its core competitive advantage. Its products integrate AI, IoT, and advanced algorithms to enable precise, intelligent, and efficient device control. The company offers flexible manufacturing capabilities, rapid response to customer needs, and comprehensive after-sales service, positioning itself as a reliable partner for leading appliance and electronics manufacturers. Its global production layout and digitalized operations further enhance delivery efficiency and customer satisfaction.
